approximation: Only the gold positives are run: R@Gold is recall over the 585 verified pairs, so the negatives of the paper's 'balanced evaluation set' (hard negatives with S >= 70 and sim > 0.8, plus random negatives, counts unreported) are not needed for this claim and the companion FPR (28.6%) is therefore not reproduced. The prompt's two entity slots are filled with the released ontology entity lists (ent_names_d / ent_names_p); the repository's few-shot script instead fills them with an entity-overlap score hint, and the paper does not say which filling the Table 14 0-shot run used. Device and patent text are truncated to 400 characters, as that script does. The released gold standard covers 74 devices, the paper's Table 14 caption says 85.
